base.manifest_rule: the W1 manifest's entry for each path below must name the same SHA-256 as this file; the manifest itself is read, not pinned (it is never changed, addendum section 18 point 1)
base.script_use: loaded by path from the bytes that passed the SHA-256 check (never imported by name, copied or edited); its build() runs with two of its module functions replaced for that call only: lists_of (the S3 subset size rule) and check_sizes (the stop)
base.settings_use: REQ-6's own settings, loaded by build_s_pool.py's literal pin and passed to its build() unchanged; its min_pool (1,000) and lists.s3_subset.size (1,000) are not used by D-1's rule (planned_s3_subset_size below must equal the latter)

decision: post-W1 deviation D-1, decided by the lead under the user's delegation (2026-10-23T13:35 UTC)

fallback.rule: addendum section 18 point 7: if k < 600 the S3 subset is all N rows in the sealed order and the decoy is not built; this wrapper then stops with counts only and exit code 3 (nothing written), so no k-row subset that the fallback replaces is ever written

k_min_rule: S3 trains on the top 48 of its subset by REQ-11's score (write_score_add.json scorers.s3.k), so no k below 48 is allowed
min_pool_rule: the S1 size plus the S4 candidates' size plus decoy_rows of REQ-6's settings (48 + 512 + 37); the wrapper refuses settings where this sum differs
name: d1_s_pool

outputs.full: --full-out, inside a folder named tmp: s_pool.json, s1.json, s3_subset.json, s4_candidates.json, s3_safe.pool.json (build_s_pool.py's own writers; the S3 subset and s3_safe hold k rows from the subset)
outputs.record: --out: s_pool_record.json (text-free; build_s_pool.py's record with its provenance block replaced by the wrapper's and a d1 block added)

reference: .ai/briefs/stage1-commitments-build-20261016-lead-decisions.md section 18 (REQ-6 stopped: the S-pool has 947 rows, not 1,000; post-W1 deviation D-1)
requirement: REQ-6 under post-W1 deviation D-1 (addendum section 18 points 2-4); everything else of REQ-6 unchanged (section 18 point 1)
rule: the S3 subset is the first k ids of sealed_order(S-pool ids, s3.subset), k the largest integer k <= planned_s3_subset_size (1,000) and k <= N for which at least decoy_rows (37) S-pool rows lie outside S1 (the first 48 of s1.order), the first k ids and the S4 candidates (the first 512 of s4.order over the S-pool minus S1); the rule reads ids and sealed orders only, never a model output
stop: counts only, nothing written: N < min_pool (597) after the last filter, or no k >= k_min (48) meets the rule, or S1 or the S4 candidates cannot be filled; the stop message carries the candidate count, N after each filter and each filter's removals by reason (build_s_pool.filter_counts)
unchanged: the candidate rule, every filter and its order, S1 (48), the S4 candidates (512), REQ-8's 37-row decoy, every sealed order and label, every output file's format and every W1 file (addendum section 18 point 1)
